label: does not affect
type: an operation on the subject deliberately leaves the object intact - the explicit negation of cascadesTo.
note: Promoted as its own relation rather than as a negated cascadesTo because the docs state it deliberately and readers need it: DROP FUNCTION leaves the external library in place, and Capella UI authentication and programmatic access are disjoint systems. Absence of cascade is a fact, not a gap in the data.
